column1: # MP armory roster - the source of truth for the two MP-only armory screens (Allied + Axis).
# One row = one weapon TILE. Regenerate everything with: python docs/tools/gen_mp_armory.py build
# This file feeds ONLY the MP screens. The coop armory (ui/loadout/, gen_loadout.py,
# loadout_weapons.tsv, coop_mod/loadout*.scr) is never read for output and never touched.
# DECISIONS BAKED IN (mp_decisions_2026-09-13.md "MP armories slice 1 answers"):
#  * Sniper = every scoped rifle that is NOT fully automatic (scoped bolt AND scoped semi-auto:
#    Springfield, Kar98 sniper, scoped Garand, G43, SVT). Fully-automatic scoped guns (scoped StG44)
#    count toward their base class - so coop cls "sniper" -> MP SNIPER, coop cls "heavy" stays MG.
#  * HEAVY split into MG / SHOTGUN / ROCKET.
#  * Allied = US/UK/USSR weapons + Trench Gun. Axis = German/Italian/Japanese + Trench Gun.
#  * Free starters: one per class per side (P1: the stock class kit gun), Axis SNIPER = Kar98K Sniper
#    and Axis SHOTGUN = Trench Gun (U3). Everything else ships LOCKED (real progression is a later slice).
#  * Gewehr 98 its own Axis RIFLE tile (A1); Gewehrgranate a LOCKED Axis ROCKET tile, dmclass shotgun (U3).
#  mpid     the tile id. == the coop weapon id where one exists; new tiles get their own (76, 77).
#  coop_id  the docs/tools/loadout_weapons.tsv id used to DERIVE give/name/cd/xfm and, via
#           coop_mod/loadoutroster.scr::roster_get, ammo/ammoN. "-" = a NEW tile, columns explicit.
#  tab      RIFLE SNIPER SMG MG SHOTGUN ROCKET PISTOL NADES (SAPPER is reserved, no tiles this slice)
#  starter  1 = free (unlocked now); 0 = locked ("Unlocks with MP progression"). Exactly one per side,tab.
#  landmine 1 = only on landmine maps (SAPPER; none this slice)
#  give/name/cd/ammo/ammoN/dmclass  "-" = derive from coop_id; a value overrides (used by new tiles)
